_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wee ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika Tic Tac Toe.
Lengo lako ni kushinda matatu mfululizo (mlalo, wima, au diagonal) kwenye ubao.
Wakati wa zamu yako, unapaswa kuchagua nambari ya mraba (0-8) unayotaka kuweka alama yako kwenye hatua inayofuata.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' huweka alama yako katika seli ya katikati ya ubao.
Kama Mchezaji {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ũndũ ũla ũnatũtavisye kĩlungunĩ kĩĩ ũtumaa tũsũanĩa ta tũtonya kũelewa nesa ngewa ĩsu.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} sio seli halali. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} ameweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
